text:
Maria Chen: Hey infra team — onboarding a seed tenant (Orion) in ap-northeast-5. They need p5.24xlarge and g5.12xlarge capacity. Requesting quota increases:
- p5 instances: 8 -> 48
- p4d instances: 0 -> 8
- g5 instances: 0 -> 24
- ENI IPs per account: increase to 5000
Need NAT/EIP plan for 4 AZs. Pilot starts next Wed. Any immediate blockers?

Aj Patel: Put the AWS account ID and preferred AZs.

Maria Chen: Account: 987654321000. Preferred AZs: ap-northeast-5a/b/c/d. We'll distribute: p5 in a/b, g5 in c/d, p4d spread across all.

Lucas Rivera: Can you confirm VPC subnet sizes? /22 in each AZ? EIP pool for NAT gateway — do we have spare EIPs in that region?

Maria Chen: VPC subnets are /22 in each AZ. No spare EIPs; we'll need elastic IPs or allocate NAT Gateways with shared EIPs. Also want IPv4-only for now.

cloudops-bot: PRECHECK: Ensure account 987654321000 has entitlements and billing agreement signed. Also run `aws ec2 describe-instances --region ap-northeast-5` to check existing usage.

Aj Patel: I've started an internal quota request to AWS. Giving them anticipated steady-state numbers and spike buffer. If AWS is slow, we can provision a small fallback in us-east-1 (latency tradeoff) until quotas are granted.

Nina Park: Cost note — p5 at scale will be expensive. For pilot, suggest using spot for non-critical batch runs and reserved/dedicated for steady inference QPS. We should model cost for 48 p5 and 24 g5 for 30 days.

Maria Chen: Opening AWS support case now. Email/template:
```
Account: 987654321000
Region: ap-northeast-5
Requested increases:
  p5.24xlarge: 48
  p4d.24xlarge: 8
  g5.12xlarge: 24
Request reason: Production pilot for Orion tenant; predictable throughput and data isolation required. Need ENI/IP capacity to 5000.
```

aws-quota-bot: Support case created: 12345678901. AWS ETA: 3-5 business days. Case link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/12345678901

Lucas Rivera: Filed internal tracking INFRA-4321 for subnet/EIP allocation and NAT configuration. Assigned to me. Will update if we need to rework AZ mapping.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. @Aj can you follow up with AWS next week if no response? :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: Yep. I'll ping AWS on day 4 and escalate if no update. :rocket:

cloudops-bot: Checklist updated: quota case, internal ticket, subnet check, cost estimate. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: I'll also prepare a canary plan to route 10% traffic to us-east-1 fallback if needed.

Nina Park: +1 on canary. Also add a cold-start test for p4d instances in the staging account.

aws-quota-bot: Update: Case 12345678901 moved to 'Information needed' — AWS requests VPC IDs and recent billing agreement. Please attach.

Maria Chen: Attached VPC ids and billing doc to the case. Re-notifying here once they confirm.

Aj Patel: Noted. I'll add a note with our expected sustained vCPU and network egress profiles to speed approval.

Maria Chen: Last call — anything else we're missing? :thinking_face:

Lucas Rivera: Keep an eye on ENI quotas per-AZ, sometimes those are the real limiter. I'll add a small buffer in our request.

Maria Chen: Great. Thanks team. We'll wait for AWS and plan fallback. :pray:
